independentReview.scope: companyAuth/Para completion, companyStore transaction ordering, expired-link recovery, revoked/deleted target races, same-target retries, finalization outage and stale UI responses
independentReview.result: No concrete authorization bypass or blocking regression found.
independentReview.independentChecks: 18 Para backend cases passed on Node20; 15 early-entry DOM cases passed on Node24.

regressions: Revocation and deletion before identity mapping or immediately before final wallet binding reject the link and do not recreate a deleted target.
Ordinary sign-in cannot use an unfinished explicit-link mapping.
An expired unbound link recovers to a fresh account, without exposing the target save.
A wallet binding committed before a finalization outage recovers to the same original account and save.
A delayed old request cannot bind after the expired reservation has been safely replaced.
Session expiry during existing-account consent cannot reveal Home.
A wallet invalidated during refresh closes an already-open app.
Signing out during an outstanding consent request cannot reopen the old account.
